prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Final visual prototype for "Here With You". Input image 1 is the SELECTED logo: reuse its exact rounded speech-bubble outline with three voice strokes at top, and its humanist sans-serif Here With You wordmark. Do not use overlapping pages or substitute a new logo. Input image 2 is the previous app layout; input 3 is previous web layout. Preserve calm minimal Airy Sage style: warm white, pale sage, forest gray-green text, restrained muted sage actions, fine dividers, elegant modest serif page headings, sans serif UI. No saturated colours, gradients, drop shadows, cards, redundant headings, giant brand mark, or marketing hero. EXACT three destinations Home / Journal / Symptom, singular Symptom. No Pages navigation. Selected listening-line logo modestly in brand header, exact name Here With You. Example content only, no invented real personal data. Tiny outside caption "Final visual prototype · example data". This is not a clinical dashboard and has no aggregate health score.DELIVERABLE mobile app board THREE matching phone screens side by side, thin discreet frames and safe areas, legible text, Home / Journal / Symptom active correspondingly on each. Brand header has selected listening-line logo and wordmark, not old overlapping pages. HOME screen: Today heading, 24 October, "A little space to check in.", Record a note, today's note title and SHORT excerpt only "Less tired today. I'd like to keep the afternoon gentle.", Open journal link and View symptom trends link. JOURNAL screen: Journal heading, Daily note title "A slower Saturday", date "24 Oct 2026", text "Less tired today. The nausea has eased, but my back feels more painful. I'd like to keep the afternoon gentle." Earlier note "23 Oct · An afternoon outside". Main mic action "Record a note". small edit icon. SYMPTOM screen: heading Symptom, Symptom view includes Last 5 days period selector, All symptoms dropdown (choices All, Fatigue, Nausea, Pain, Appetite loss, Sleep difficulty), one overlaid chart with five separate symptom lines and readable named legend. Five dates Oct20,21,22,23,24. Actual sample values Fatigue6,5,4,4,3;Nausea4,3,3,2,2;Pain3,3,4,4,5;Appetite loss7,6,5,4,3;Sleep difficulty5,4,5,3,4. Y ticks0,5,10. Small legend "Severity · 0 none — 10 severe". Chart colours restrained eucalyptus, slate, warm stone, olive, charcoal, distinct dash patterns/markers, readable contrast. No shaded chart fills. No single rating in All view. Bottom navigation on all three screens only Home/Journal/Symptom. Preserve previous minimal structure, no unnecessary new content. Compact mic action on Home and Journal. Make final coherent polished phone product presentation, more minimal than the old multicolour version.
